fact: The Office of the Prime Minister's monthly U-NIEWS Issue 91 (15 June-15 July 2024), prepared with the Uganda National Meteorological Authority, carries a crop and pasture conditions map and an NDVI anomaly analysis with farmer advisories.
title: U-NIEWS Monthly National Integrated Multi-Hazard Early Warning Bulletin, Issue 91
publisher: Office of the Prime Minister, Department of Relief, Disaster Preparedness and Management (NECOC)
